newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes higher as tech strength continues.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes higher as tech strength continues.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks continued to draw on high techs for support to close higher, with Dell Computer Corp one of the day's winners.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 7.56 points, or 0.62 percent, at 1219.65 at its unofficial close while advances led declining issues by 2,153 to 1,896 on volume of about 596 million shares.

"It's a nifty-fifty kind of move," said Phil Roth, chief technical analyst at Dean Witter Reynolds. "It's not so much a Nasdaq rally, as breadth has been negative most of the week, but a move in the blue chip high tech stocks. People are confused about the economic environment and about interest rates and the feeling is to buy a stock like Intel Corp no matter what happens."
Intel, which saw a series of strong upward moves this week after an upbeat forecast last Monday, closed 3/8 higher at 97-3/8 in active trading.
Dell, which rose 3-3/8 to 86-1/2 in active trade, led the PC-makers higher.
"(I)t all boils down to the fact that fundamental trends are very positive for Dell," an industry analyst said.
